messages:
nina: Idea: run a 1-week "Refkit Mini Lab" focused on community tutorials + a tiny benchmark leaderboard. Goal: 50 signups, 40 bench submissions, and 30 new stars on the repo.
chris: Love it. Keep it low-friction: 3 short tutorials (setup, routing, quantization) and one simple bench script users can run locally.
alexa: Landing form minimum fields: name, email, github, region, use_case, bench_url, utm. HubSpot tag = refkit_minilab_2403.
tom: I'll set up a small `bench/collect` endpoint that accepts `results.json` and stores to a bucket. CLI: `./submit_bench.sh results.json`.
brynn: Social plan: 5 posts (launch, daily prompts, reminder, webinar invite, recap). A/B test two CTAs: "Build a refapp" vs "Measure your model".
chris: Repo layout: /tutorials/01-03, /bench, /examples/docker, README with challenge checklist. include CONTRIBUTING.md.
alexa: Owners: nina = lead, chris = tech content, brynn = socials, tom = infra. Deadlines: repo + tutorial PRs by Tue, landing page staged Wed, assets Thu.
launch-bot: Reminder: staging landing live by 1714070000 for QA.
brynn: Prize = sticker pack + featured community showcase. Keep it modest; main KPI is bench submissions.
chris: Bench example: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-1b --seq 512 --batch 4 --cpu` outputs {"latency_ms": 42, "tokens": 512}. docs will show required schema.
alexa: Nurture flow: 3-email drip for submitters (tips -> community highlights -> webinar replay). tag leads in HubSpot list `minilab_submitters`.
nina: OK everyone — I'll send the calendar for a quick sync Fri 9am PT. Keep replies to essentials in this thread. :rocket:
